title: NorthShore Health Centers
description: NorthShore Health Centers offers comprehensive care in Indiana, including behavioral health, dental, pediatrics, and women’s health. It runs multiple health centers and mobile units across Porter, Lake, La Porte, and Jasper counties. Sector: Hospitals & Physicians Clinics. Location: Chesterton, Indiana. Revenue: $84.3 million. Employees: 201-500.
